title: CarrierCancellation
description: A cancellation, as Norvia's P7 Carrier cancellation Logic App sends it to a Carrier's cancellation endpoint (Carrier cancellation format, version 1). It follows the Carrier booking format: its own field names and the same keys. It tells the Carrier about a Withdrawn booking (never answered, so no Carrier booking reference) or a Cancelled one (Confirmed, so with the Carrier's own reference and a reason). The Carrier can't refuse it. The Carrier booking number is its key: a cancellation sent again is ignored.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The Carrier booking that ended, the key of the cancellation.

carrierBookingReference.description: The Carrier's own number for the booking, given when it confirmed. Only for CANCELLED.

shipmentNumber.description: The Shipment the Carrier booking covered.

kind.description: WITHDRAWN: Norvia took back a request the Carrier hadn't answered. CANCELLED: Norvia ended a booking the Carrier had confirmed.

reasonText.description: Why Norvia cancelled. Required for CANCELLED.
